rules.title: Owner move-in eviction relocation assistance (2026 inflation-adjusted amounts)
rules.requirement: Owners who evict a tenant for owner move-in must pay relocation assistance. From January 1, 2026, the standard payment is $19,413, plus an additional $6,471 for qualifying households. Amounts are indexed annually to the SF-Oakland-San Jose CPI.
rules.key_value: $19,413 standard; +$6,471 for qualifying households (2026; +1.5% CPI adjustment)
rules.coverage_conditions: Tenants in Berkeley rental units evicted for owner move-in under the Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only when an owner move-in eviction occurs; additional payment only for qualifying households (criteria not stated in document).

rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance (relocation assistance provisions)
rules.quoted_span: The Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance requires owners to pay tenants relocation assistance in the event of an owner move-in eviction.
rules.conflict_note: Document does not give a municipal code section number; 2026 amounts approved by Rent Board on October 16, 2025 and effective January 1, 2026.

rules.title: Ellis Act eviction relocation assistance (2026 inflation-adjusted amounts)
rules.requirement: Owners who evict tenants to withdraw a property from the rental market under the Ellis Act must pay the same relocation assistance as for owner move-in evictions. From January 1, 2026, the standard payment is $19,413, plus $6,471 for qualifying households, indexed annually to CPI.
rules.coverage_conditions: Tenants in Berkeley evicted so the owner can remove the property from the rental housing market (Ellis Act withdrawal).

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only when an Ellis Act withdrawal eviction occurs; additional payment only for qualifying households (criteria not stated in document).

rules.citation: Berkeley Ellis Implementation Ordinance (relocation assistance provisions)
rules.quoted_span: The Ellis Implementation Ordinance requires the same relocation assistance payments for tenants evicted so the owner can remove a property from the rental housing market.
rules.conflict_note: Document does not give a municipal code section number; 2026 amounts approved by Rent Board on October 16, 2025 and effective January 1, 2026.
